packs.title: Birds of the World 1
packs.description: Twenty-two striking birds from around the world.

cards.name: Bald Eagle
facts: The bald eagle lives in North America.
Bald eagles build some of the biggest nests of any bird.

cards.name: Puffin
facts: The puffin has a bright orange beak.
Puffins dive underwater to catch small fish.

cards.name: Flamingo
facts: The flamingo is pink.
Flamingos get their pink color from the food they eat.

cards.name: Emperor Penguin
facts: The emperor penguin lives in Antarctica.
The emperor penguin is the tallest penguin.

cards.name: Barn Owl
facts: The barn owl hunts at night.
Barn owls have a heart-shaped face.

cards.name: Peacock
facts: The peacock has a long, colorful tail.
A peacock spreads its tail feathers like a fan.

cards.name: Toucan
facts: The toucan has a very big beak.
Toucans live in South America.

cards.name: Hummingbird
facts: The hummingbird is very small.
Hummingbirds can fly backwards.

cards.name: Mallard Duck
facts: The mallard is a duck.
The male mallard has a shiny green head.

cards.name: Ostrich
facts: The ostrich is the biggest bird.
Ostriches cannot fly, but they run very fast.

cards.name: Blue Jay
facts: The blue jay has blue feathers.
Blue jays like to eat acorns.

cards.name: Cardinal
facts: The male cardinal is bright red.
Cardinals have a crest of feathers on their head.

cards.name: Kingfisher
facts: The kingfisher catches fish.
Kingfishers dive straight into the water.

cards.name: Pelican
facts: The pelican has a pouch under its beak.
Pelicans scoop up fish with their pouch.

cards.name: Swan
facts: The swan has a long neck.
Baby swans are called cygnets.

cards.name: Robin
facts: The robin has an orange chest.
Robins sing even in winter.

cards.name: Woodpecker
facts: The woodpecker pecks holes in trees.
Woodpeckers find insects under tree bark.

cards.name: Macaw
facts: The macaw is a parrot.
Macaws can live for more than fifty years.

cards.name: Snowy Owl
facts: The snowy owl is white.
Snowy owls live in cold places in the Arctic.

cards.name: Chicken
facts: The chicken lays eggs.
A male chicken is called a rooster.

cards.name: Seagull
facts: The seagull lives near the sea.
Seagulls eat fish and many other foods.
cards.file: American Herring Gull, Brooklyn Army Terminal (01813).jpg

cards.name: Roadrunner
facts: The roadrunner runs fast.
Roadrunners live in the desert.

packs.title: Wild Animals 1
packs.description: Big and small mammals from every continent.

cards.name: Elephant
facts: The elephant has a long trunk.
Elephants are the biggest animals on land.

cards.name: Giraffe
facts: The giraffe has a very long neck.
Giraffes are the tallest animals in the world.

cards.name: Lion
facts: The lion is a big cat.
Lions live together in groups called prides.

cards.name: Tiger
facts: The tiger has stripes.
No two tigers have the same stripes.

cards.name: Zebra
facts: The zebra has black and white stripes.
Zebras live in Africa.

cards.name: Hippopotamus
facts: The hippopotamus loves water.
Hippos spend most of the day in rivers and lakes.

cards.name: Rhinoceros
facts: The rhinoceros has horns on its nose.
Rhinos eat grass and leaves.

cards.name: Gorilla
facts: The gorilla is a big ape.
Gorillas live in forests in Africa.

cards.name: Cheetah
facts: The cheetah runs very fast.
The cheetah is the fastest animal on land.

cards.name: Panda
facts: The panda is black and white.
Pandas eat bamboo.

cards.name: Kangaroo
facts: The kangaroo hops.
A mother kangaroo carries her baby in a pouch.

cards.name: Koala
facts: The koala lives in trees.
Koalas eat eucalyptus leaves.

cards.name: Polar Bear
facts: The polar bear lives on the ice.
Polar bears are very good swimmers.
cards.file: Polar bear (Ursus maritimus) in the drift ice region north of Svalbard.jpg

cards.name: Brown Bear
facts: The brown bear is big and strong.
Brown bears sleep through most of the winter.

cards.name: Wolf
facts: The wolf howls.
Wolves live and hunt in packs.

cards.name: Fox
facts: The fox has a bushy tail.
Foxes can hear very quiet sounds.

cards.name: Moose
facts: The moose has big antlers.
The moose is the largest kind of deer.

cards.name: Camel
facts: The camel has a hump.
Camels can go a long time without water.

cards.name: Chimpanzee
facts: The chimpanzee is an ape.
Chimpanzees use sticks as tools.

cards.name: Sloth
facts: The sloth moves very slowly.
Sloths hang upside down in trees.

cards.name: Hedgehog
facts: The hedgehog has spines.
A hedgehog rolls into a ball to stay safe.

cards.name: Squirrel
facts: The squirrel climbs trees.
Squirrels bury nuts to eat later.

packs.title: Vehicles 1
packs.description: Things that go — on roads, rails, water and in the air.

cards.name: Bicycle
facts: The bicycle has two wheels.
You push the pedals to make a bicycle go.

cards.name: Dump Truck
facts: The dump truck carries dirt and rocks.
The back of a dump truck tips up to pour out its load.

cards.name: Bus
facts: The bus carries many people.
A bus stops at bus stops along its route.

cards.name: Fire Truck
facts: The fire truck helps put out fires.
Fire trucks carry ladders and hoses.

cards.name: Ambulance
facts: The ambulance takes people to the hospital.
An ambulance has flashing lights and a siren.

cards.name: Tractor
facts: The tractor works on farms.
Tractors have big back wheels.

cards.name: Excavator
facts: The excavator digs.
An excavator has a big bucket on a long arm.

cards.name: Bulldozer
facts: The bulldozer pushes dirt.
Bulldozers move on tracks instead of wheels.

cards.name: Helicopter
facts: The helicopter has spinning blades.
A helicopter can fly straight up and down.

cards.name: Airplane
facts: The airplane flies in the sky.
Big airplanes carry hundreds of people.

cards.name: Hot Air Balloon
facts: The hot air balloon floats.
Hot air makes the balloon rise.

cards.name: School Bus
facts: The school bus is yellow.
School buses take children to school.

cards.name: Submarine
facts: The submarine goes under the water.
A submarine can stay underwater for a long time.

cards.name: Steam Train
facts: The steam train puffs smoke.
Steam trains burn coal or wood to boil water.

cards.name: Tram
facts: The tram runs on rails in the street.
Trams get power from wires above them.

cards.name: Garbage Truck
facts: The garbage truck picks up trash.
Garbage trucks squash the trash inside.

cards.name: Tow Truck
facts: The tow truck pulls cars.
A tow truck helps when a car breaks down.

cards.name: Road Roller
facts: The road roller flattens the road.
A road roller has a big, heavy drum instead of front wheels.

cards.name: Snowplow
facts: The snowplow pushes snow off the road.
Snowplows have a big blade in front.

cards.name: Cement Mixer
facts: The cement mixer spins.
The drum turns to keep the cement from getting hard.

cards.name: Police Car
facts: The police car has flashing lights.
Police officers drive police cars.

cards.name: Container Ship
facts: The container ship carries big boxes.
Container ships cross the oceans.
